description: anton's bead skeleton: the contract sections every bead carries, one step per tier (epic / feature / ticket). COOK it and materialise with `bd create --description` — never POUR it: a poured molecule root is issue_type=molecule, which is not one of anton's tiers and falls out of the board's parent walk. Every variable default below is a PROMPT, not content: an author fills it. Shipping a fabricated Acceptance box is worse than an absent one, because the self-review gate scores the diff against it (docs/runbooks/bead-contract-conformance.md). NOTE placeholders are scanned everywhere in this file, so prose here must not contain one.

title.description: The bead's title — an outcome for an epic, one PR's worth of change for a feature, one step for a ticket

outcome.description: Epic only: the result its features add up to, in one line a stakeholder would recognise
outcome.default: TODO — the outcome these features add up to, in language a stakeholder would recognise

success_criteria.description: Epic only: how we know the outcome is reached — what several features add up to, not one PR's checklist
success_criteria.default: - [ ] TODO — the observable state that means this outcome is reached

goal.description: One sentence: the outcome this delivers and why it matters
goal.default: TODO — one sentence: what this delivers, and why it matters

acceptance.description: Concrete, checkable boxes — the run's definition of done and the rubric self-review scores the diff against
acceptance.default: - [ ] TODO — a concrete, checkable statement of done

context.description: Which files/areas this touches and which pattern to follow, so the agent doesn't rediscover them
context.default: TODO — touches: <files/areas>; follow the pattern in <file>

out_of_scope.description: The explicit non-goals that bound the change
out_of_scope.default: - TODO — what this deliberately does not change

verify.description: The tests that prove it landed, and which to add
verify.default: TODO — the tests that prove this landed, and which to add

steps.title: {{title}}
{{title}}
